summary: Keep daily release bodies within GitHub's limit and attach complete release notes

replay.detail: Release tooling only; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change.

manual.detail: No runtime upgrade action required. Daily releases always attach complete RELEASE-NOTES.md; oversized release bodies omit the per-change list while retaining upgrade impact and upgrade guidance, or refuse publication if essential guidance exceeds the safe limit. Dry runs report body sizing.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
